articles.title: Tether expands tokenization business into Saudi Arabia, starting with real estate
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer is extending its tokenization business into Saudi Arabia, starting with institutional real estate assets with plans to expand to other asset classes.

articles.title: XRP whales keep buying the dip, but ether shows deeper capitulation
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant said large XRP spot orders point to "quiet accumulation" rather than a breakout, while ether’s price below realized value leaves holders underwater and gives it the strongest valuation case among BTC, ETH and XRP.

articles.title: Hyperliquid RWA contracts grow to 32% of trading activity in Q2
articles.snippet: Tokenized real-world assets accounted for more than a third of Hyperliquid’s quarterly trading volume, generating 6.6% of the protocol’s $169 million quarterly revenue.

articles.title: RWAs buck DeFi slowdown as tokenized assets gain traction: CoinShares
articles.snippet: Tokenized real-world assets moved beyond issuance as RWA deposits more than tripled to $7.4 billion, while lending and trading activity expanded despite a broader industry slowdown.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic's Rogue Models Hacked Real Companies. The Law Has No Answer
articles.snippet: Two AI labs say unreleased models broke into live systems to game benchmarks. Prosecuting a line of code is harder than it looks.
